def check_constraints():
    from z3 import Int, Bool, Or, Not, And, Solver, sat

    # Base script constraints
    ectx_int = Int('ectx_int')
    s = Solver()
    s.add(ectx_int == 0)

    # Constraint set 2 variables
    ectx = Bool('ectx')
    check = Bool('check')
    pctx_is_null = Bool('pctx_is_null')
    text = Bool('text')
    pubin = Bool('pubin')
    print_public_failed = Bool('print_public_failed')
    print_private_failed = Bool('print_private_failed')
    no_public = Bool('no_public')
    set_include_public_1_ok = Bool('set_include_public_1_ok')
    set_include_public_0_ok = Bool('set_include_public_0_ok')
    asn1_encoding_nonnull = Bool('asn1_encoding_nonnull')
    set_asn1_encoding_ok = Bool('set_asn1_encoding_ok')
    point_format_nonnull = Bool('point_format_nonnull')
    set_point_format_ok = Bool('set_point_format_ok')
    out_is_null = Bool('out_is_null')
    eckey_is_null = Bool('eckey_is_null')
    app_passwd_ok = Bool('app_passwd_ok')
    opt_cipher_ok = Bool('opt_cipher_ok')
    opt_check_rest_arg_ok = Bool('opt_check_rest_arg_ok')
    opt_provider_ok = Bool('opt_provider_ok')
    opt_string_asn1_ok = Bool('opt_string_asn1_ok')
    opt_string_point_ok = Bool('opt_string_point_ok')
    opt_format_out_ok = Bool('opt_format_out_ok')
    opt_format_in_ok = Bool('opt_format_in_ok')

    # Constraint set 2 expressions
    s1 = Or(Not(check), Not(pctx_is_null))
    s2 = Or(Not(text),
            Not(Or(And(pubin, print_public_failed),
                   And(Not(pubin), print_private_failed))))
    s3 = Or(Not(Not(no_public)), Not(Not(set_include_public_1_ok)))
    s4 = Or(Not(no_public), Not(Not(set_include_public_0_ok)))
    s5 = Not(And(asn1_encoding_nonnull, Not(set_asn1_encoding_ok)))
    s6 = Not(And(point_format_nonnull, Not(set_point_format_ok)))
    s7 = Not(out_is_null)
    s8 = Not(eckey_is_null)
    s9 = Not(Not(app_passwd_ok))
    s10 = Not(Not(opt_cipher_ok))
    s11 = Not(Not(opt_check_rest_arg_ok))
    s12 = Not(Not(opt_provider_ok))
    s13 = Not(Not(opt_string_asn1_ok))
    s14 = Not(Not(opt_string_point_ok))
    s15 = Not(Not(opt_format_out_ok))
    s16 = Not(Not(opt_format_in_ok))

    s.add(s1, s2, s3, s4, s5, s6, s7, s8, s9, s10, s11, s12, s13, s14, s15, s16)

    return s.check() == sat
